Use case: stylized-concept. Four original Soul of Meal character portrait paintings, exactly TWO columns TWO rows on a square canvas with no borders. Reference image shows the four CANON characters left-to-right, preserve all identities and exact core costume colors. Portrait order: upper-left banana-leaf turtle Bánh chưng; upper-right teal carp elder Chả cá; lower-left white-haired humanoid crane woman Bún thang; lower-right violet-haired humanoid swallow fairy Bánh cốm. Each cell a single centered head-and-torso portrait with face completely visible, rich cel-painted anime fantasy card art, golden jade Vietnamese cooking-world atmosphere, readable at thumbnail. Turtle carries leaf pack/bronze shield; carp has skillet staff/dill; crane has bowl staff and fine yellow threads; fairy has mint ribbons and square green ornament. Four distinct low-contrast backgrounds: leaf-wrapped family hearth, indigo riverside cooking pavilion, delicate white-gold broth threads, lavender mint silk courtyard. No letters, UI, gridlines, watermarks, other characters or food photographs. Identity details:
1. banh-chung: Stocky green TURTLE guardian with a round warm young face, large square emerald banana-leaf parcel backpack tied in conspicuous RED cords, segmented bronze rice-grain breastplate, red waist tassel, bronze round drum shield with a sun-wheel motif, and one SHORT bamboo-bronze baton in other hand. Turtle snout and round green limbs, no fur. Strong low wide silhouette. Preserve green/bronze/red identity from the FIRST reference column. Controlled heavy steps, shield-leading baton attack, cast braces and lifts shield. Not a lion or long-neck tortoise.
2. cha-ca-la-vong: Noble elderly TEAL CARP scholar guardian, large expressive round fish eyes, long white curved moustache and short white beard, indigo Vietnamese ao dai with delicate GOLD botanical hems and dill-green sleeve lining, jade belt, small round DARK scholar hat with gold band. ONE gold skillet-headed staff, held upright or diagonally so entire pan and staff fit. Broad teal fish head with fin-like ears and short stout humanlike robed body. Soft composed elder personality, measured steps, deliberate skillet-staff swing, casting conducts fragrance from pan. Preserve SECOND reference column. No turtle shell, no animal fur.
3. bun-thang: Graceful adult female humanoid CRANE SPIRIT, not an animal-headed bird: fair human face, very long ivory-white hair, small white crane feather crest with red tassel and golden blossom hairpin, pale yellow and ivory Vietnamese ao dai over cream trousers, white feather wing sleeves/cape, ONE slender gold staff ending in a small bowl of fine golden egg/noodle threads. Slender upright silhouette, light precise steps, sweeps bowl staff diagonally, casting opens feather sleeves and conducts fine threads. Preserve the THIRD reference column's human face, white hair, yellow outfit and white wings. No red rooster comb or huge firebird wings. No steam painted on actor.
4. banh-com-hang-than: Adult female humanoid SWALLOW FAIRY, not deer or animal-headed: fair human face, short dark-violet bob hair with swept purple swallow feathers and small pale-gold blossom ornament, lavender-and-mint Vietnamese ao dai, unmistakable SQUARE GREEN cake-knot ornament at waist, layered purple swallow-feather wing cape and TWO long mint silk ribbons. Delicate compact silhouette distinct from white-haired crane. No staff or new weapon: fights by guiding physical wing-ribbons in compact hand gestures. Light turning steps, wing-ribbon cut attack, casting ties a compact square ribbon knot with hands. Preserve FOURTH reference column's human face, purple bob, mint lavender outfit and ribbons. No antlers.

Use case: stylized-concept. Soul of Meal original transparent VFX animation atlas. EXACTLY THREE columns by FOUR rows, portrait canvas ratio 3:4. TWELVE isolated magical clusters, each centered SMALL inside only the middle 60% of its own cell, with broad transparent gutters all around. NO physical character, human body/face, text, grid, background, ground or opaque screen wash. All rows have three sequential frames LEFT-TO-RIGHT: compact gathering / strong readable impact / dissolving finisher. ROW1 Bánh chưng: unmistakable SQUARE emerald banana-leaf ward with crossed RED rice-package ties and fine bronze rim; gather folded corner lines, impact broad woven square protection, dissolve leaf strips and knots. ROW2 Chả cá: GOLD SKILLET spiral with TEAL water steam and feathery DILL fronds; gather pan-shaped coil, impact rolling aroma-pan spiral pointing diagonally, dissolve delicate dill/water droplets. ROW3 Bún thang: THREE fine GOLDEN EGG THREADS woven with WHITE crane-feather strokes and tiny ivory bowl crescent; gather thin upright strands, impact clear diagonal three-thread fan with a delicate crane neck curve, dissolve fine light stitches. No fire or blades. ROW4 Bánh cốm: interlocking MINT and LAVENDER SILK loops tied around a small SQUARE JADE center, swallow-tail ribbon silhouette; gather single knot, impact elegant paired ribbon loops, dissolve two long tails and tiny pale blossoms. Distinct shapes, not recolors of same circle. Rich polished painted fantasy VFX with crisp cores and restrained soft edges, no huge bloom. Keep every cluster completely inside its own cell, never overlap neighbors.
